title: Personal Issues (Easy Version)
statement: The task is to find the optimal score difference in a tree game with n up to 3000: from zeros at x and y, players alternately zero a vertex, scoring when exactly one neighbor is zero. The value is always 0 or 1, so it reduces to a normal-play game over which x–y path vertex stays last, solved by interval DP on the path with free-move parity.
